answer: Each identity files one marble job in the oasis registry, locking an 80-credit bond and paying a 10-credit fee. The ledge ledger stamps it with a seed-assigned deadline, and on-time delivery refunds the bond. One operator completes at most 50 deliveries per epoch, so the k-th job costs 10 credits inside it and 90 beyond it. For 1,000 fake jobs, 50 cost 500 and 950 burn 85,500, totalling 86,000. An auditor recomputes ledge timestamps against oasis deadlines, exposing lateness. A deadline-shopping ring pays 30 per extension for no gain. An honest marble worker pays 10 and recovers the bond.
